modal.title: Terms and Conditions — Drivique
modal.subtitle: Read carefully before accepting · Law 1581/2012 · Law 527/1999
modal.legalNote: By accepting, you declare that you have read and understood these terms in their entirety.

clausulas.texto: Drivique provides vehicle rental services to individuals over 18 years of age with a valid driver's license. The contractual relationship is finalized upon electronic acceptance of these terms, pursuant to Article 14 of Law 527 of 1999 (e-commerce).

In compliance with Statutory Law 1581 of 2012 and Regulatory Decree 1377 of 2013, Drivique acts as Data Controller. Collected data (email) will be used exclusively for: (i) rental service provision, (ii) sending confirmations and notifications, (iii) fulfilling legal obligations. Data will not be shared without prior consent, except as required by law. You may exercise access, correction, deletion, and revocation rights by contacting privacidad@Drivique.com.

clausulas.titulo: Accuracy of Information and User Responsibility
clausulas.texto: The user declares under oath that information provided is true and current. Providing false information constitutes a punishable offense under Article 286 of the Colombian Penal Code. Drivique is exempt from civil and criminal liability arising from false information or identity theft.

The user is solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their credentials (email and password). Any activity carried out with these credentials will be presumed to be performed by the account holder. In case of security compromise, notify soporte@Drivique.com immediately.

Checking the "I accept terms and conditions" box constitutes a valid electronic signature with full legal effect under Law 527 of 1999. Acceptance is logged with date, time, and IP address for audit purposes.
Drivique may modify these terms by notifying the registered email at least 15 days in advance. Continued use of the platform after this period implies acceptance of the changes.
This agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of Colombia. Any controversy will be resolved before competent courts in the city of Bogotá D.C.

descriptions.1: Sedán confiable y espacioso, ideal para viajes largos o uso diario en la ciudad. Ofrece una excelente relación de consumo de combustible y un maletero generoso para todo tu equipaje. Máxima comodidad.
descriptions.2: SUV premium que destaca por su gran presencia y comodidad para toda la familia. Incluye techo panorámico, acabados de lujo y tecnología de seguridad avanzada para brindarte tranquilidad. Excelente diseño.
descriptions.3: Vehículo compacto, ágil y muy económico, perfecto para moverte rápidamente por la ciudad. Te permite estacionar sin complicaciones y ofrece un rendimiento de combustible insuperable para el día a día. Gran elección.
descriptions.4: Ícono deportivo inconfundible equipado con un potente motor V8 de alto rendimiento. Pensado exclusivamente para quienes buscan sentir la adrenalina pura y vivir una experiencia de conducción verdaderamente única y emocionante.
descriptions.5: Imponente SUV de 8 pasajeros equipada con tracción 4x4. Es la opción ideal para realizar viajes familiares largos con total confort o para enfrentarse a terrenos exigentes sin ningún problema. Capacidad extrema.
descriptions.6: Vehículo compacto ideal para la ciudad, con un habitáculo súper cómodo para 5 pasajeros. Cuenta con un excelente rendimiento de combustible que cuida tu bolsillo durante todos tus desplazamientos diarios. Gran vehículo.
descriptions.7: Sofisticada SUV híbrida, reconocida por ser muy eficiente y silenciosa. Cuenta con un amplio espacio de carga y lo último en tecnología de asistencia al conductor para mayor seguridad. Tecnología limpia.
descriptions.8: Elegante sedán moderno y confortable, diseñado con un gran maletero y acabados de altísima calidad. Es el compañero perfecto tanto para trayectos diarios como para viajes importantes de negocios. Confort garantizado.
descriptions.9: SUV híbrida premium que ofrece una gran eficiencia de combustible. Su interior destaca por un hermoso techo panorámico y un espacio muy generoso tanto para pasajeros como para su equipaje. Viajes inolvidables.

DRIVIQUE RENTAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS

contratoFirma.title: Reservation and rental agreement
contratoFirma.subtitle: Drivique · Academic vehicle rental platform
contratoFirma.autoGenNote: Document auto-generated from your reservation data. You only need to review it and sign.
contratoFirma.intro: Between THE PLATFORM, Drivique, and THE USER, {{nombre}}, identified with {{tipoDoc}} {{numDoc}}, this reservation and vehicle rental agreement is entered into, automatically generated from the information registered in the system.
contratoFirma.clause1Text: This agreement governs the reservation and temporary use of the {{marca}} {{modelo}} vehicle, plate {{placa}}, for the period between {{inicio}} and {{fin}}.
contratoFirma.clause2Text: The contract is created automatically using the user's personal data, vehicle information, selected branch, branch city, payment method and total reservation value. THE USER only needs to review the information and sign.
contratoFirma.clause3Item1: Provide truthful, current and complete information.
contratoFirma.clause3Item2: Use the vehicle responsibly and in accordance with applicable regulations.
contratoFirma.clause3Item3: Be liable for damages, fines or breaches attributable to their use.
contratoFirma.clause3Item4: Return the vehicle at the agreed time and place, unless a change is approved in the system.
contratoFirma.clause4Text: Drivique must generate, display and store this contract linked to the reservation, allowing its review before signing and its digital retention.
contratoFirma.clause5Text: THE USER authorizes the use of their data to manage the reservation, generate the contract, record the signature, store digital evidence and maintain process traceability.
contratoFirma.clause6Text: Drivique is an academic platform developed for the analysis, design and implementation of a digital vehicle rental system.
contratoFirma.signHere: Sign here with your mouse or finger
contratoFirma.footerNote2: Academic and functional use within the reservation and digital contracting flow.
